The '''Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] main military force in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the fleet came under the direct control of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] when he broke away from the Empire and formed his own warlord faction. The fleet became the backbone of [[Moff Sarne's forces|Sarne's military forces]].
